item.title: Lucky You: The Best St. Patrick’s Day Plans in Denver
item.description: Though Denver resides over 4,000 miles away from Ireland, there’s plenty of Irish pride circulating around the Mile High City this St. Patrick’s Day. In fact, the Rocky Mountains saw plenty of Irish settlers during the silver boom in the late 1800s, and by the early 1900s many relocated to Denver.
